features.description: Load source GeoJSON governorate geometry, demographic snapshots, rainfall histories and environmental report. Distinguish loading/error/missing-data and retry. GeoJSON is required to show a meaningful map.
Select population,IDP,IDP returnees,rainfall or environmental layer; choose date/source snapshot where available. Rainfall uses one layer without a source-row selector.

Native polygon choropleth with full source geometry including Golan, fit bounds and zoom controls. Counts use data-driven10/40/70percent-of-max thresholds, rainfall latest available year and environment temperature bands. Legend and fill share classification logic.

Tap a province to inspect its metric and details; desktop hover tooltip becomes native callout/sheet. No-data provinces stay explicitly unknown. Canonical governorate names map Arabic/English dataset aliases.
Select up to2 provinces from map or accessible source table, toggle off and reset. Third selection replaces oldest. Compare all demographic datasets with current layer/source alignment.
Open/close responsive data panel, list source date/note/citation URL, governorate values and country total; rows can select comparison without requiring map precision.

Click province to see all available annual rainfall/average records and mini chart/table. Map fill uses latest available year, not a hard-coded calendar year. There is no year slider in current source.
Province detail shows coordinates,population,current temperature/feels-like/weather,min/max,humidity,wind speed/direction,pressure,cloud cover and precipitation with missing-value states.
Province cards show AQI category/health recommendation, drought classification/annual rain/dry months, temperature/rainfall trends and historical weather summary.
Unselected environment panel shows report collection/date/sources, key findings, climate challenges, water basins and recommendations. Preserve source dates, estimates and units.

Provide equivalent data-table values and comparison controls for chart/polygon users who cannot precisely tap a province. Native layout must retain panel controls beside/under map and reservation-free content.
